scope.purpose: Where the FFmpeg 8.0.1 source comes from. The image's FFmpeg is built from the FFmpeg 8.0.1 release tarball (packaging/ffmpeg/build-contract.json). This record also lists the Ubuntu source package whose original tarball is byte-for-byte the same file, with the other files of that package.

officialRelease.check: Downloaded on 2026-10-11 and compared: the size and SHA-256 equal those of ffmpeg_8.0.1.orig.tar.xz in the Ubuntu source package below, which is the file the Dockerfile checks.

scope.note: Ubuntu's own ffmpeg binary package of this version is GPL-enabled and is not installed in any image; the images contain the custom LGPL-only build described in packaging/licenses/NOTICE.md.

verification.method: gpgv against the existing WSL Ubuntu archive keyring; Sources.xz SHA-256 and size matched the signed InRelease SHA256 section.
